propositions: Write-op parameters (force, reason, caused_by, ref, close_class) are hand-mirrored across lib/CLI/MCP adapters with no mechanical enforcement, allowing silent drift in parameter exposure
A behavioral conformance oracle tests all write-op surface variants against a shared contract table through all three adapters to detect parameter divergence without LLM or change-detection
Runtime conditional rules (close_class required, reason required for REASON_REQUIRED_CLASSES) must be asserted behaviorally on every adapter to ensure consistent rejection of invalid states

MCP adapter has known gaps (reason/caused_by/force not exposed on transition_ticket/claim_ticket) that are encoded as strict-xfail rows citing scratchy-leprous-galago to keep suite green until those gaps are closed

The oracle reuses and extends the existing three-adapter harness (Outcome, Adapter protocol, Library/CLI/MCP drivers) by threading write-op parameters through the protocol rather than creating parallel drivers
